title: Annual Ornament Sale Happening Now
bodyHtml:
pwsbuilder November 9, 2020

Don’t miss our Annual Holiday Ornament Sale! Weekends Thru Mid-December & Black Friday from 11am-4pm at The Art Gallery of the Guild of Harwich Artists.

The Guild of Harwich Artists’ annual holiday ornament sale is a popular attraction that raises money for a good cause. This year the ornaments will be on sale weekends through mid-December. The 75+ inventory will be refreshed weekly as our 70-members complete their original paintings.

Hand-painted miniature oil and framed watercolor paintings by members of the GHA are available at $15 each.

Payment by check or cash. Many of the ornaments are inspired by holiday images of Cape Cod and make wonderful stocking stuffers.

Posted in WHAT'S NEW
